status: M2. 6-DOF Monte Carlo (sim6 v2.3, 500 runs per case, 34 cases) on reference vehicle RV-1c (ledger v3c): mechanical.json v1 engine module (CG pivot, 146 mm body for the 140 mm engine-bay ID of the founder decision 2026-10-12, final) + the combustion v2 engine growth relayed by the lead; engine = combustion.json v1 throttle map x combustion v2 relay factors (S230 straight-port grain, pre-publication: see engine_model); electronics.json v1 servo/latency data. Requirements below supersede v1 where restated; the 1-D v1 sweeps are kept where the 6-DOF does not replace them. Everything here is a prediction: no hardware has been tested. Written to the lead's fallback hub during the /mnt outage.
units: SI (m, kg, s, N, Pa, K, rad) unless the key names another unit (_deg, _dps, _Hz, _g, _L, _cal)

conventions.gimbal_angle: engine axis relative to the body axis; the LIMIT applies to the vector norm sqrt(dx^2+dy^2)
conventions.success_criteria: touchdown |vz| <= 2.0 m/s, v_h <= 0.5 m/s, tilt <= 5.0 deg, tilt rate <= 10.0 deg/s, no propellant exhaustion, no tip-over (REQ brief)
conventions.statistics: success P with Wilson 95 % interval; p99 = 99th percentile over landed runs; paired McNemar exact test against the baseline where the dispersion draws are identical (same seed and sequence)

recommended_baseline.tag: DERIVED descent-attitude trade + 6-DOF MC (REPORT B, landing_closure)
recommended_baseline.note: Full-thrust ascent under TVC (aft fins) -> MECO on predicted apogee (300 m) -> nose-first coast -> nose drogue at apogee (engine-down, liquid settled aft) -> relight planned on the latest ignition (0.6 s) at ~35-45 m and ~22 m/s -> drogue released on Pc-confirmed ignition -> throttled TVC landing burn (velocity-tracking reference + PI, PD lateral to the reachable pad target, disturbance feed-forward) -> 8 m terminal gate -> touchdown ~1.1 m/s -> engine cut on contact. Roll by N2O-vapour RCS couple throughout.

why: best landing closure of the full-profile options: P 0.984 [0.969, 0.992] vs A-F free fall P 0.988 [0.974, 0.994]
lowest N2O load of the full profiles: 1.74 kg sized vs A-F 2.21 kg
drogue gives a passive engine-down attitude and settles the liquid for the relight; relight at ~22 m/s instead of ~50 m/s
drogue is also a degraded recovery path if the relight fails (vehicle loss, low-energy impact)
2 starts per flight; ENG-04 >= 3 keeps one spare
costs_and_risks: drift under the drogue: median miss 78 m, p95 155 m (wind U(0,8) m/s); an upwind ascent bias from the pad wind measurement cuts the median to 28 m
relight at ~35-45 m leaves no time for a backup main parachute: ignition reliability is mission-critical
drogue release and line/plume clearance at relight (Lauty: release + swivel at the nose)
the passive drogue phase is the least modelled part (quasi-steady tension, no inflation transient)

baseline_numbers.tag: SIM sim6 v2.3 nominal A-D (no wind, no noise) at the MC load; MC percentiles from the baseline case

1_continuous_burn_hop.verdict: test-campaign profile (tethered/low hops) and fallback; not for 300 m

test_campaign: T0 bench: gimbal + servos (stiffness, rocking mode and damping, backlash, hinge torque, slew vs angle), IMU bias/temperature, LiDAR/GNSS, structural command filter in the ECU, drogue-release actuator

T1 static fires (DC-D): ignition latency distribution (>= 30 starts), throttle map and Pc loop (t10-90, slew, resolution, floor stability), 3 starts per run, gimbal sweeps under thrust, thrust-vector alignment, ENGINE ROLL TORQUE, rocking mode under thrust
T2 tethered hover (DC-C): 0.5-2 m; hover, doublets, TVC attitude hold, estimator and thrust-effectiveness estimator, roll RCS
T3 low hops (B, 5-50 m then 100 m) with the hover-capable floor; legs fixed; landing guidance and lateral divert
T4 drogue drop tests (no engine, dummy mass): deployment, swing, drift, release
T5 relight hop (A-D mini: MECO ~60-100 m, drogue, relight ~30-40 m)
